privileged_info_for_vlm: The target CRS is EPSG:3857. In gvSIG, this may appear under aliases: 'Pseudo-Mercator', 'Web Mercator', 'Popular Visualisation CRS', or 'Google Mercator'. The final project must be saved specifically to '/home/ga/gvsig_data/projects/mercator_project.gvsproj'. Visual confirmation of the projection change: WGS84 (4326) looks like a flat rectangle (equirectangular), while Web Mercator (3857) significantly distorts/enlarges areas near the poles (e.g., Greenland looks huge).
